# Purdue University
> Purdue University is a public research university advancing education, discovery, and innovation across science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and beyond.

Purdue serves prospective and current students, faculty, staff, researchers, alumni, and partners through admissions, academic programs, campus life, research initiatives, extension services, libraries, and athletics. This guide emphasizes authoritative university, admissions, academic, research, and student-resource pages across Purdue’s web presence.

## University Overview
- [Home](https://www.purdue.edu/home/): Purdue’s main gateway for university-wide information, news, and primary audience navigation.
- [About Purdue](https://www.purdue.edu/home/about/): Overview of Purdue’s mission, history, leadership, and institutional identity.
- [Academics](https://www.purdue.edu/home/academics/): Central overview of colleges, schools, programs, and academic opportunities.
- [Life at Purdue](https://www.purdue.edu/home/life-at-purdue/): Introduction to student life, housing, dining, organizations, and campus experience.
- [Research](https://www.purdue.edu/home/research/): University-level entry point for research strengths, partnerships, and innovation.
- [Alumni](https://www.purdue.edu/home/alumni/): Alumni engagement, events, giving, and lifelong connection resources.
- [Athletics](https://www.purdue.edu/home/athletics/): Official athletics overview and links to Purdue sports programs.

## Admissions
- [Become a Student](https://www.purdue.edu/home/become-a-student/): Starting point for prospective students exploring Purdue admissions and enrollment paths.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/): Official undergraduate admissions site with application guidance and requirements.
- [Apply to Purdue](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/apply/): Application options, deadlines, and next steps for undergraduate applicants.
- [Majors at Purdue](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/majors/): Searchable directory of undergraduate majors and academic interests.
- [Visit Purdue](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/visit/): Campus tours, visit events, and virtual visit planning resources.
- [Tuition and Financial Aid](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/costsandfinaid/): Costs, scholarships, aid programs, and affordability information for applicants.
- [International Students](https://www.admissions.purdue.edu/international/): Admissions guidance, requirements, and support for international applicants.

## Academics and Programs
- [Office of the Registrar](https://www.purdue.edu/registrar/): Academic records, registration, calendars, transcripts, and student enrollment services.
- [Academic Catalog](https://catalog.purdue.edu/): Official catalog of programs, courses, degree requirements, and academic policies.
- [Purdue University Online](https://www.purdue.edu/online/): Online degrees, certificates, and digital learning opportunities across Purdue.
- [Online Programs of Study](https://www.purdue.edu/online/programs-of-study/): Browse Purdue’s online academic and professional programs by area and credential.
- [Honors College](https://honors.purdue.edu/): Honors curriculum, community, admissions, and student opportunities.
- [Libraries and School of Information Studies](https://www.lib.purdue.edu/): Library services, research support, collections, and information literacy resources.
- [Summer Session](https://www.purdue.edu/summer/): Summer courses, registration details, and academic planning information.

## Colleges and Schools
- [College of Engineering](https://engineering.purdue.edu/): Engineering programs, departments, research, and student resources.
- [College of Science](https://www.purdue.edu/science/): Science departments, research initiatives, and undergraduate and graduate programs.
- [Daniels School of Business](https://business.purdue.edu/): Business degrees, faculty, research, and student career development resources.
- [College of Agriculture](https://ag.purdue.edu/): Agriculture academics, extension connections, and research programs.
- [College of Education](https://www.education.purdue.edu/): Teacher preparation, learning sciences, and education research programs.
- [College of Pharmacy](https://www.pharmacy.purdue.edu/): Pharmacy education, research, and professional training information.
- [College of Health and Human Sciences](https://www.purdue.edu/hhs/): Health, human development, and consumer sciences programs and research.
- [College of Liberal Arts](https://cla.purdue.edu/): Humanities, social sciences, communication, and arts programs.

## Graduate and Professional Education
- [The Graduate School](https://www.purdue.edu/gradschool/): Graduate admissions, policies, funding, professional development, and student support.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.purdue.edu/gradschool/admissions/): Application requirements, deadlines, and admissions processes for graduate study.
- [Professional Master's Programs](https://www.purdue.edu/gradschool/prospective/professional-masters.html): Overview of career-focused master’s degree options at Purdue.
- [Graduate Funding](https://www.purdue.edu/gradschool/fellowship/): Fellowships, assistantships, and funding opportunities for graduate students.
- [Purdue Online Graduate Programs](https://www.purdue.edu/online/): Online graduate degrees and certificates offered across disciplines.

## Student Life and Campus Resources
- [Housing and Residence Life](https://www.housing.purdue.edu/): On-campus housing options, contracts, move-in, and residential support services.
- [Dining and Culinary](https://dining.purdue.edu/): Dining courts, meal plans, menus, and campus food services.
- [Student Activities and Organizations](https://www.purdue.edu/odos/sao/): Student involvement, organizations, leadership, and campus engagement resources.
- [Purdue Student Union Board](https://www.purdue.edu/unionboard/): Student programming, events, and campus entertainment opportunities.
- [Recreation and Wellness](https://www.purdue.edu/recwell/): Fitness facilities, intramurals, wellness programs, and recreation services.
- [Office of the Dean of Students](https://www.purdue.edu/odos/): Student support, advocacy, conduct, and campus assistance resources.
- [Protect Purdue Health Center](https://www.purdue.edu/push/): Student health services, appointments, immunizations, and medical support.
- [Career Success](https://www.cco.purdue.edu/): Career advising, internships, job search tools, and employer connections.

## Research and Innovation
- [Research at Purdue](https://www.purdue.edu/research/): Central hub for research administration, initiatives, and institutional strengths.
- [Office of Research](https://www.purdue.edu/research/oevprp/): Research leadership, policies, compliance, and support for investigators.
- [Purdue Innovates](https://www.purdue.edu/innovates/): Commercialization, startups, entrepreneurship, and innovation support programs.
- [Discovery Park District](https://www.purdue.edu/discoveryparkdistrict/): Research, industry collaboration, and innovation district development initiatives.
- [Sponsored Program Services](https://www.purdue.edu/research/oevprp/sps/): Proposal submission, award management, and sponsored research administration.
- [Research Integrity and Regulatory Affairs](https://www.purdue.edu/research/oevprp/regulatory-affairs/): Compliance, ethics, and regulatory oversight for research activities.

## Extension, Outreach, and Public Service
- [Purdue Extension](https://extension.purdue.edu/): Statewide educational outreach in agriculture, health, youth, and community development.
- [Purdue Agriculture Extension](https://ag.purdue.edu/extension/): Agriculture-focused extension programs, resources, and county-based services.
- [4-H Youth Development](https://extension.purdue.edu/4h): Youth programs, leadership development, and experiential learning through Indiana 4-H.
- [Center for Career Opportunities](https://www.cco.purdue.edu/): Career services supporting students and employer engagement across the university.
- [Purdue Global Partnerships and Professional Education](https://www.purdue.edu/online/): Continuing education and workforce-oriented online learning opportunities.

## Libraries, IT, and Administrative Services
- [Purdue Libraries](https://www.lib.purdue.edu/): Research help, databases, archives, and library services for the Purdue community.
- [IT at Purdue](https://www.it.purdue.edu/): Enterprise technology services, accounts, security, and campus IT support.
- [OneCampus Portal](https://one.purdue.edu/): Unified portal for Purdue applications, systems, and personalized campus services.
- [Office of the Bursar](https://www.purdue.edu/bursar/): Billing, payments, refunds, and student account services.
- [Financial Aid](https://www.purdue.edu/dfa/): Aid eligibility, FAFSA guidance, scholarships, and student financial support.
- [Human Resources](https://www.purdue.edu/hr/): Employment, benefits, payroll, and workplace resources for faculty and staff.

## News and Athletics
- [Purdue University News](https://www.purdue.edu/newsroom/): Official university news, research announcements, and media resources.
- [Purdue Today](https://www.purdue.edu/newsroom/purduetoday/): Campus news and announcements for faculty, staff, and students.
- [Purdue Athletics](https://purduesports.com/): Official athletics site with teams, schedules, rosters, and ticket information.
- [Boilermakers](https://purduesports.com/): Coverage of Purdue varsity sports and athletic department updates.
- [Alumni Association](https://www.purdueforlife.org/): Alumni programs, events, networking, and Purdue community engagement.
- [Purdue for Life Foundation](https://www.purdueforlife.org/): Alumni relations, fundraising, and donor engagement across Purdue.
